name: fastapi-canonical
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is FastAPI, a Python web framework for building APIs from standard Python type
hints. It declares path, query, header, cookie, body, form and file parameters and validates them, injects
dependencies (including dependencies with `yield`, class dependencies and security schemes), filters and
serializes responses through response models, handles errors, streams JSON Lines and Server-Sent Events,
organizes applications with routers and sub-applications, and generates the OpenAPI schema and the
documentation pages that use it.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the fastapi Python package under fastapi/ (except the fastapi/__main__.py launcher), together with these English documentation pages under docs/en/docs/: tutorial/path-params.md, tutorial/query-params.md, tutorial/body.md, tutorial/query-params-str-validations.md, tutorial/query-param-models.md, tutorial/body-multiple-params.md, tutorial/cookie-params.md, tutorial/header-params.md, tutorial/cookie-param-models.md, tutorial/header-param-models.md, tutorial/response-model.md, tutorial/response-status-code.md, tutorial/request-forms.md, tutorial/request-form-models.md, tutorial/request-files.md, tutorial/handling-errors.md, tutorial/path-operation-configuration.md, tutorial/encoder.md, tutorial/dependencies/index.md, tutorial/dependencies/classes-as-dependencies.md, tutorial/dependencies/sub-dependencies.md, tutorial/dependencies/dependen
